clips.title: The story
paras: At the Far Watch Post, Kargal Battlescar guards the eastern edge of the Barrens. He watches the crossing from Durotar, judges incoming recruits, and sends capable fighters west to strengthen Horde defenses.

Kargal Battlescar watches the road into the Barrens from the Far Watch Post. Travelers and new adventurers cross the bridge over the Southfury River, leaving the Valley of Trials behind. The Barrens is a dangerous, contested land, where aggressive wildlife, centaur raiders, and quilboar tribes threaten the frontier. Kargal inspects those who pass and gathers willing recruits for the Horde. He sends them onward to the Crossroads, where they can aid local commanders in securing the frontier.
